requirement_text: All changes to the System hosting environment are logged and tracked.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want all changes to the hosting environment logged and tracked, so that I can see who changed what.
technical_task: Log and track every change made to the hosting environment of the System.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change to the hosting environment, when it is made, then it is logged.
Given a logged change, when the log is reviewed, then the change can be tracked.

requirement_text: The system shall print a formatted bill for the customer.
user_story: As a cashier, I want to print a formatted bill for the customer, so that the customer gets a record of the sale.
technical_task: Provide bill printing in a formatted layout for the customer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed sale, when the cashier prints the bill, then a formatted bill is printed for the customer.
Given a printed bill, when it is read, then it shows the details of the sale.
rationale: Role assumed: cashier. The layout is not specified.

requirement_text: Internal notes on applicants shall be maintainable.
user_story: As a recruiter, I want to maintain internal notes on applicants, so that my team shares what it knows.
technical_task: Allow internal notes on applicants to be created and edited.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant, when the recruiter adds a note, then it is saved with the applicant.
Given an existing note, when the recruiter edits it, then the change is stored.

requirement_text: Access to these capabilities must be through a secure channel that ensures all content is encrypted and integrity-protected in accordance with the standard for encryption and hashing algorithms specified at § 170.210(f).
user_story: As a security officer, I want access to these capabilities only over a secure channel with encrypted, integrity-protected content, so that data cannot be read or altered in transit.
technical_task: Provide access to the capabilities only through a secure channel that encrypts and integrity-protects all content using the encryption and hashing algorithms specified at § 170.210(f).
acceptance_criteria: Given a request to use the capabilities, when it is made over an insecure channel, then access is refused.
Given a request over the secure channel, when content is exchanged, then it is encrypted and integrity-protected according to § 170.210(f).
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. "These capabilities" refers to an earlier requirement that is not included.

requirement_text: Authorised networks shall be listed (or automatically selected if automatic selection has been enabled) in the following order: (M) home EIRENE network; foreign EIRENE networks; public networks.
requirement_text_raw: 10.5.1 Authorised networks shall be listed (or automatically selected if automatic selection has been enabled) in the following order: (M) home EIRENE network; foreign EIRENE networks; public networks.
user_story: As a railway user, I want authorised networks listed in a fixed order, so that my home network is preferred.
technical_task: List the authorised networks, or select them automatically when automatic selection is enabled, in the order home EIRENE network, foreign EIRENE networks, public networks.
acceptance_criteria: Given authorised networks are available, when they are listed, then the order is home EIRENE network, foreign EIRENE networks, public networks.
Given automatic selection is enabled, when a network is selected, then it follows the same order.
rationale: Role assumed: railway user. The (M) tag in the source is not interpreted.

requirement_text: User shall easily maintain the system due to its modular design, especially concerning frequent changes in database contents.
clarification_questions: What maintenance effort or time is meant by "easily"?
What counts as a "frequent" change in database contents?

requirement_text: Store contact details of a received SMS or e-mail to the address book application.
requirement_text_raw: 3. Store contact details of a received SMS or e-mail to the address book application.
user_story: As a user, I want contact details from a received SMS or e-mail saved to the address book, so that I can reach the sender later.
technical_task: Store the contact details of a received SMS or e-mail in the address book application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a received SMS, when the user chooses to store the contact, then the details are saved in the address book application.
Given a received e-mail, when the user chooses to store the contact, then the details are saved in the address book application.

requirement_text: The data mentioned in requirement 3.4.2.2 and any other Draper-provided telemetry data shall fit within Draper’s allocated telemetry budget of 5000 bits/sec.
requirement_text_raw: The data mentioned in requirement 3.4.2.2 and any other Draper-provided telemetry data shall (3.4.2.9) fit within Draper’s allocated telemetry budget of 5000 bits/sec.
user_story: As a telemetry engineer, I want the listed data and any other Draper-provided telemetry to fit in Draper's 5000 bits/sec budget, so that the allocation is not exceeded.
technical_task: Keep the data from the referenced requirement and any other Draper-provided telemetry data within Draper's allocated telemetry budget of 5000 bits/sec.
acceptance_criteria: Given the telemetry data, when the combined rate is measured, then it does not exceed 5000 bits/sec.
Given a rate above 5000 bits/sec, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: telemetry engineer. The referenced requirement is not included in the text.

requirement_text: System shall integrate with Pure to enable dataset deposition and management within the platform.
user_story: As a researcher, I want the system to integrate with Pure, so that I can deposit and manage datasets within the platform.
technical_task: Integrate with Pure for dataset deposition and management.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when the user deposits it, then it is stored via Pure.
Given a deposited dataset, when the user manages it, then the management happens within the platform.

requirement_text: Necessary offset compensation shall only base on comparison of the signals among each other and an appropriate averaging over time and driven distance.
user_story: As a sensor engineer, I want offset compensation based only on comparing the signals and on averaging over time and driven distance, so that no outside reference is used.
technical_task: Base any necessary offset compensation solely on the comparison of the signals with each other and on an appropriate averaging over time and driven distance.
acceptance_criteria: Given offset compensation is needed, when it is calculated, then it uses only the comparison of the signals among each other and averaging over time and driven distance.
Given an input from any other source, when compensation is calculated, then it is not used.
rationale: Role assumed: sensor engineer. "Appropriate" averaging is not quantified.

requirement_text: If sensors usses daisy chain see PSI 5 specification v 1.3 for details (adressing).
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What does the PSI 5 specification say about daisy chain addressing?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The system shall allow camp administrators to modify added parents' information.
user_story: As a camp administrator, I want to change the information of parents I added, so that records stay correct.
technical_task: Allow camp administrators to modify the information of added parents.
acceptance_criteria: Given an added parent, when the camp administrator edits the information and saves, then the change is stored.
Given a modified parent record, when it is viewed, then the new information is shown.

requirement_text: If the vehicle was parked for longer than T_STANDBY, the position assignments of the four wheel sensors are redetermined in the subsequent trip.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want wheel sensor positions determined again on the next trip after a long parking time, so that assignments stay correct.
technical_task: Redetermine the position assignments of the four wheel sensors on the next trip when the vehicle was parked for longer than T_STANDBY.
acceptance_criteria: Given the vehicle was parked for longer than T_STANDBY, when the next trip starts, then the position assignments of the four wheel sensors are redetermined.
Given the vehicle was parked for no longer than T_STANDBY, when the next trip starts, then the assignments are not required to be redetermined.
rationale: Role assumed: vehicle engineer. The value of T_STANDBY is not given.

requirement_text: The solution should support remote monitoring and administration via Netscape Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) IETF Secure Shell (SSH) IETF IP Security (IPSEC) or similar secure method.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should support remote monitoring and administration via Netscape Secure Sockets Layer (SSL)  IETF Secure Shell (SSH)  IETF IP Security (IPSEC) or similar secure method.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want remote monitoring and administration over SSL, SSH, IPSEC or a similar secure method, so that remote access is protected.
technical_task: Support remote monitoring and administration through Netscape Secure Sockets Layer (SSL), IETF Secure Shell (SSH), IETF IP Security (IPSEC) or a similar secure method.
acceptance_criteria: Given a remote administrator, when connecting, then SSL, SSH or IPSEC can be used.
Given remote monitoring, when it is carried out, then it runs over a secure method.

requirement_text: The system shall ensure multi-lingual support, with English, Turkish, Finnish, and Italian as supported languages due to replication partnerships.
user_story: As an international user, I want the system in English, Turkish, Finnish and Italian, so that partners in each language can use it.
technical_task: Provide multi-lingual support for English, Turkish, Finnish and Italian.
acceptance_criteria: Given the language setting, when a user picks Turkish, Finnish or Italian, then the system is shown in that language.
Given the language setting, when a user picks English, then the system is shown in English.
rationale: Role assumed: international user. The replication partnerships are the stated reason.

requirement_text: Connectors, couplers or plugs must not have sharp edges or any radius smaller than 0.5 millimetres, to avoid damages of cable harness or injuring of assembler.
user_story: As an assembler, I want connectors, couplers and plugs without sharp edges or radii below 0.5 millimetres, so that I am not injured and the cable harness is not damaged.
technical_task: Design connectors, couplers and plugs without sharp edges and with no radius smaller than 0.5 millimetres.
acceptance_criteria: Given a connector, coupler or plug, when it is inspected, then it has no sharp edges.
Given a connector, coupler or plug, when its radii are measured, then none is smaller than 0.5 millimetres.

requirement_text: Support Services shall continue to close and reopen a faulty MPCC device until status shows that the device has recovered.
requirement_text_raw: Support Services shall [SRS242] continue to close and reopen a faulty MPCC device until status shows that the device has recovered.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Support Services to keep closing and reopening a faulty MPCC device until it recovers, so that transient faults clear.
technical_task: Have Support Services repeat closing and reopening a faulty MPCC device until its status shows recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Given a faulty MPCC device, when its status shows a fault, then Support Services closes and reopens it.
Given the status shows the device has recovered, when Support Services checks it, then it stops closing and reopening the device.

requirement_text: Details of the signal group and the application ID are within the actual CAN matrix.
rationale: The sentence says where details are found and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a statement about where details are kept?
What must the system do with the signal group and application ID?

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to record changing the date and time where the clinical solution allows this to be done.
user_story: As an auditor, I want changes of the date and time recorded where the clinical solution allows them, so that time changes are traceable.
technical_task: Record each change of the date and time in the clinical solution wherever the solution allows it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the clinical solution allows the date and time to be changed, when it is changed, then the change is recorded.
Given the clinical solution does not allow the change, when the date and time are viewed, then no change is recorded.

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide status data to the application about each FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC used for command data.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS304] provide status data to the application about each FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC used for command data.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to give the application status data for each FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC used for command data, so that I can monitor the links.
technical_task: Provide status data to the application for every FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC that is used for command data.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC used for command data, when the application asks, then FTSS provides the status data of that link.
Given several such links, when the application asks, then FTSS provides status data for each of them.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to select a specific train schedule for further details (e.g., departure time, platform number).
user_story: As a traveller, I want to select a train schedule to see details such as departure time and platform number, so that I can plan my trip.
technical_task: Allow a specific train schedule to be selected and show its details, for example departure time and platform number.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of train schedules, when the user selects one, then its details are displayed.
Given the details, when they are displayed, then they include the departure time and the platform number.

requirement_text: System shall direct the user to respective account pages for login and terms acceptance.
user_story: As a user, I want to be taken to the right account pages for login and terms acceptance, so that I can finish both steps.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the respective account pages for login and for terms acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who needs to log in, when the user continues, then the login account page is shown.
Given a user who must accept terms, when the user continues, then the terms acceptance account page is shown.

requirement_text: The solution should comply with the Privacy Rule that protects all individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity or its business associate in any form or media whether electronic paper or oral.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should comply with the Privacy Rule that protects all individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity or its business associate  in any form or media  whether electronic  paper  or oral.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the solution to follow the Privacy Rule for individually identifiable health information, so that it is protected in any form.
technical_task: Comply with the Privacy Rule protecting all individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity or its business associate in electronic, paper or oral form.
acceptance_criteria: Given individually identifiable health information held by a covered entity or its business associate, when it is processed, then the Privacy Rule is followed.
Given the information in electronic, paper or oral form, when it is transmitted, then it is protected under the Privacy Rule.

requirement_text: Master Password has no limits in length. A whole sentence can be used with more than 100 characters.
user_story: As a user, I want a master password without a length limit, so that I can use a whole sentence of more than 100 characters.
technical_task: Accept master passwords of any length, including whole sentences with more than 100 characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a master password of more than 100 characters, when the user sets it, then it is accepted.
Given a master password in the form of a whole sentence, when the user enters it, then it works to unlock.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to choose to view "tatkaal" or "normal" applicants.
user_story: As a user, I want to choose to view "tatkaal" or "normal" applicants, so that I can focus on one kind.
technical_task: Provide a choice between viewing "tatkaal" applicants and "normal" applicants.
acceptance_criteria: Given the applicant list, when the user chooses "tatkaal", then only tatkaal applicants are shown.
Given the applicant list, when the user chooses "normal", then only normal applicants are shown.

requirement_text: User shall download attached files from experiments using a web browser or a network drive.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to download files attached to experiments through a web browser or a network drive, so that I can use them offline.
technical_task: Offer downloads of the files attached to experiments via a web browser or via a network drive.
acceptance_criteria: Given an experiment with attached files, when the user downloads a file using a web browser, then the file is downloaded.
Given an experiment with attached files, when the user accesses a file through a network drive, then the file can be retrieved.

requirement_text: The system requires end users to provide their symptoms accurately to avoid false predictions.
user_story: As a patient, I want to enter my symptoms accurately, so that the predictions are not false.
technical_task: Require end users to enter their symptoms to the system for predictions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the symptom form, when the end user enters symptoms, then the symptoms are used for the prediction.
Given the symptom form, when no symptom is provided, then no prediction is made.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. The accuracy of user input cannot be enforced by the system.

requirement_text: User shall select a specific car from the list.
user_story: As a customer, I want to pick a specific car from the list, so that I can see or choose it.
technical_task: Provide a list from which a specific car can be selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of cars, when the user selects one, then that car is chosen.
Given a chosen car, when the next page is displayed, then it refers to that car.

requirement_text: The product must record the score (time and number of counts) of a play associated with the name of a user.
user_story: As a player, I want my play's score, time and number of counts recorded with my name, so that results are attributed to me.
technical_task: Record the score of a play, being its time and number of counts, together with the name of the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a finished play, when it is recorded, then the time and the number of counts are stored.
Given a recorded play, when it is viewed, then it is associated with the name of the user.

requirement_text: The data in the database is analyzed according to the risk factors for the disease to determine if the patient exhibits one or more risk factors.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the database analyzed against disease risk factors, so that I know whether a patient has one or more of them.
technical_task: Analyze the data in the database according to the risk factors for the disease and determine whether the patient has one or more risk factors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient's data in the database, when the analysis runs, then it is evaluated against the risk factors for the disease.
Given the analysis result, when it is shown, then it states whether the patient exhibits one or more risk factors.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The risk factors are not listed.

requirement_text: Upon successful payment, the user shall be enrolled in the course.
user_story: As a learner, I want to be enrolled in a course once my payment succeeds, so that I can start learning.
technical_task: Enroll the user in the course when the payment is successful.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful payment, when it is confirmed, then the user is enrolled in the course.
Given a failed payment, when it is processed, then the user is not enrolled.

requirement_text: System shall generate notifications when the stock of a particular medicine falls below a predefined threshold.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want a notification when a medicine's stock falls below a set threshold, so that I can reorder.
technical_task: Generate a notification whenever the stock of a medicine falls below its predefined threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Given the stock of a medicine falls below its predefined threshold, when this is detected, then a notification is generated.
Given the stock is at or above the threshold, when it is checked, then no notification is generated.
rationale: Role assumed: pharmacist. The threshold values are not given.

requirement_text: The system display shall support a minimum resolution of 1024 x 576 pixels.
user_story: As a user, I want the display to support at least 1024 x 576 pixels, so that content fits.
technical_task: Support a minimum display resolution of 1024 x 576 pixels.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display of 1024 x 576 pixels, when the system is shown, then the content is displayed.
Given a display with a higher resolution, when the system is shown, then the content is also displayed.

requirement_text: In the Search or Add Patient page enter the patient's name & birth date.
user_story: As a clerk, I want to enter the patient's name and birth date in the Search or Add Patient page, so that I find or create the patient.
technical_task: Provide the Search or Add Patient page with inputs for the patient's name and birth date.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Search or Add Patient page, when it is displayed, then it has inputs for name and birth date.
Given a name and birth date entered, when the clerk submits, then the patient search or addition continues.

requirement_text: The details of the balancing concept shall be designed by the contractor.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor to design the details of the balancing concept, so that responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Assign the design of the details of the balancing concept to the contractor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the balancing concept, when its details are designed, then the contractor designed them.
Given the delivered design, when it is reviewed, then it covers the details of the balancing concept.

requirement_text: Shall a city be selected, all theatres and movies showing on that day shall be listed.
user_story: As a moviegoer, I want all theatres and movies showing that day listed when I select a city, so that I can choose a show.
technical_task: List all theatres and movies showing on the day when a city is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected city, when the list is displayed, then all theatres in it are listed.
Given a selected city, when the list is displayed, then all movies showing that day are listed.

requirement_text: The user may click in the frame that contains the remaining wall and a frame showing the discarded tiles will be shown.
user_story: As a player, I want to click the frame with the remaining wall and see a frame with the discarded tiles, so that I can check what is left.
technical_task: Show a frame with the discarded tiles when the user clicks the frame that contains the remaining wall.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frame that contains the remaining wall, when the user clicks it, then a frame showing the discarded tiles is shown.
Given the discarded tiles frame is shown, when it is displayed, then it lists the discarded tiles.
rationale: Role assumed: player. "May" makes this optional behaviour for the user.

requirement_text: User shall be able to submit complaints about deliveries or other issues, providing details for the admin to handle and resolve the complaint.
user_story: As a customer, I want to submit complaints about deliveries or other issues with details, so that the admin can handle and resolve them.
technical_task: Provide a complaint form for deliveries and other issues that passes the details to the admin for handling and resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Given the complaint form, when the customer enters details and submits, then the complaint is sent to the admin.
Given a submitted complaint, when the admin opens it, then the details are shown for handling and resolution.

requirement_text: Vehicle odometry data from the ESP to the radar sensor, may have a larger delay due to routing from Flexray to Ethernet via gateways and switches in between; to date one gateway (EIS) and one switch (IDC) is planned.
rationale: The sentence says the delay may be larger and gives no limit or required behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a note about expected delay?
What maximum delay of the odometry data is acceptable?

requirement_text: The system shall expose descriptive records for ETDs for external use.
user_story: As a researcher, I want descriptive records for ETDs available externally, so that others can discover them.
technical_task: Expose descriptive records for ETDs for external use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ETD, when an external user requests its record, then the descriptive record is provided.
Given the descriptive record, when it is read, then it describes the ETD.

requirement_text: System shall display the transaction number for reference.
user_story: As a customer, I want the transaction number displayed, so that I can refer to it later.
technical_task: Display the transaction number on completion for reference.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed transaction, when the confirmation is displayed, then the transaction number is shown.
Given a displayed transaction number, when the user quotes it, then it identifies the transaction.

requirement_text: The patient chooses a specific referral from the list to view complete details about the referral: sending HCP name and specialty receiving HCP name and specialty time generated priority office visit date and notes.
requirement_text_raw: The patient chooses a specific referral from the list to view complete details about the referral: sending HCP name and specialty  receiving HCP name and specialty  time generated  priority  office visit date  and notes.
user_story: As a patient, I want to pick a referral from the list and see its complete details, so that I know where I was referred.
technical_task: Show the complete details of a selected referral, being the sending HCP name and specialty, the receiving HCP name and specialty, the time generated, the priority, the office visit date and the notes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of referrals, when the patient picks one, then its complete details are displayed.
Given the details, when they are displayed, then they include the sending and receiving HCP names and specialties, the time generated, the priority, the office visit date and the notes.

requirement_text: System shall maintain efficiency even in the event of system failure, with recovery expected within an hour or less.
rationale: "Efficiency" is not measurable and the recovery time and the efficiency claim are mixed.
clarification_questions: What does "efficiency" mean in measurable terms during a system failure?
Does "within an hour or less" apply to all failures?

requirement_text: The sensor shall deliver fewer than 100 false alarm sensor objects per hour in all ODAs, where the number of sensor cycles the false alarm is delivered as sensor object is less than or equal 2.
user_story: As a sensor engineer, I want fewer than 100 false alarm objects per hour in all ODAs, with each false alarm delivered for no more than 2 sensor cycles, so that false alarms are rare and short.
technical_task: Limit the sensor to fewer than 100 false alarm sensor objects per hour in all ODAs, where a false alarm is delivered as a sensor object for 2 sensor cycles or fewer.
acceptance_criteria: Given any ODA, when the false alarm sensor objects are counted over an hour, then there are fewer than 100.
Given a false alarm delivered as a sensor object, when its duration is counted in sensor cycles, then it is less than or equal to 2.

requirement_text: Edit task page will be opened.
rationale: The sentence is a fragment that describes a page opening and gives no trigger or behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which action opens the Edit task page?

requirement_text: System shall store archived data directly on the HCP object store to leverage its features.
user_story: As a records manager, I want archived data stored directly on the HCP object store, so that I can use its features.
technical_task: Store archived data directly on the HCP object store.
acceptance_criteria: Given archived data, when it is stored, then it is placed directly on the HCP object store.
Given data on the HCP object store, when it is retrieved, then the object store features are available.
rationale: Role assumed: records manager. Which features are leveraged is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall establish valid temperature range based on initialization data.
rationale: The range and the initialization data are not specified.
clarification_questions: What defines a "valid" temperature range and what does the initialization data contain?
What must the system do when a reading is outside the range?

requirement_text: The system shall securely store and manage patient electronic health records, including medical history, diagnoses, treatments, and lab results.
user_story: As a physician, I want patient electronic health records stored and managed securely, including history, diagnoses, treatments and lab results, so that I can rely on them.
technical_task: Store and manage patient electronic health records securely, covering medical history, diagnoses, treatments and lab results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when a record is saved, then the medical history, diagnoses, treatments and lab results are stored securely.
Given a stored record, when it is accessed, then it is only shown to authorized users.
rationale: Role assumed: physician. The second criterion is an interpretation of "securely".

requirement_text: The user chooses to open his or her message inbox or outbox.
user_story: As a user, I want to open my message inbox or outbox, so that I can read what I received or sent.
technical_task: Provide a choice between opening the message inbox and the outbox.
acceptance_criteria: Given the messages page, when the user opens the inbox, then received messages are shown.
Given the messages page, when the user opens the outbox, then sent messages are shown.

requirement_text: System shall be available 24 hours a day.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available 24 hours a day, so that I can use it at any time.
technical_task: Keep the system available 24 hours a day.
acceptance_criteria: Given any hour of a 24 hour day, when the user opens the system, then it is available.
Given a full day of operation, when availability is checked, then it is available throughout the 24 hours.
